transkript.t: These five open-source repos let Claude Code build your game for you, right down to the soundtrack and your character's lip-sync.
So first, Unreal Claude plugs into the Unreal Editor and builds your levels while you watch.
If you're on Godot, Godot MCP play-tests your game and patches its own bugs from the air log.
Then ACE Step 1.5 turns a mood into a full soundtrack in like 10 seconds,
and Claude Code Game Studios is the one with all 49 agents.
And in Video's Audio 2 Face, 3D lip-syncs your character's face to any line of dialogue.
Comment Game and I'll get you all five repos plus how I'd set each one up.
